---
title: "About"
---

I'm Adam Kapelner, a statistician working on experimental design and
causal inference. This blog covers R packages I maintain, the statistics
behind them, and — since most of my packages end up with a C++ core for
speed — the engineering that goes into that core.

**Packages:**

- [`EDI`](https://kapelner.github.io/EDI/) (Experimental Design and
  Inference) — fixed and sequential randomized experimental designs
  (blocking, optimal designs, matching-on-the-fly, covariate-adaptive
  randomization) with inference matched to each design and response type.
  [Source](https://github.com/kapelner/EDI).
- [`edi_kernels`](https://pypi.org/project/edi_kernels/) — Python bindings
  to the same C++ model-fitting kernels, no R dependency.
